input.summary:
parts/stairs.mjs builds three spruce/pale-oak stair flights with stair_run (carve). I did not do a lighting pass, a stairwell render, or tick the plan/elements checklists.
Plot 1: x19, z11..15, facing south. Plot 2: x30, z10..14, facing south. Plot 4: z15, x57..53, facing west. All three run from y3 to the y7 floor layer.
Walk shows every room unreachable because doors aren't built yet, and plot 4's flight floats because shell B is still a stub.
left: Plot 4 flight (z15, x57..53, y3..7) was built before Shell B exists. It shows as floating in `mcd check` until shell B lays its y7 floor with the hole at x54..56 z15 and the step-out at x52 z15, plus its walls.
The rail at x18 z13 y8 in plot 1 was refused because the hump wall is there. The rail on the other side of the opening, and any rails for plots 2 and 4 that didn't land, were not checked.
`mcd walk` reports all rooms unreachable because doors and openings are still stubs. Re-run it after fittings.
Not done: no lighting pass, no `rooms` render of the stairwells, and no ticks in the plan.md or elements.md checklists. I added a note to plan.md about plot 4.
Plot 1 flight uses spruce_stairs because acacia_stairs is outside the palette.

waste.what: Checked by eye which flights float or ride on missing floors, because parts run before shell B and the walk can't be verified until doors exist
waste.tool: A walk mode that treats missing doors as passable, or reordering so stairs run after the shells and fittings

waste.what: Found out that build.mjs gives the stairs part no carve flag, and that stair material names must be palette-checked
waste.tool: stair_run should reject off-palette materials and warn when a part isn't run with carve

companions.task: Hang lanterns over each stairwell and landing once the rooms and ceilings are built
